svg.text: Clarke transform: balanced three phases become two stationary axes
Time domain: phase currents U / V / W
instantaneous phase values (balanced: u + v + w = 0)
ejθ = cos θ + j sin θ
Stationary α/β plane — snapshot at θ = 30°
α + jβ = ⅔ ( u + v·ej120° + w·ej240° ) = A·ejθ
α = ⅔ [u·cos 0° + v·cos 120° + w·cos 240°] = ⅔ (u − (v + w)/2)
at θ = 30°: u = +0.87 (red), v = 0 (blue), w = −0.87 (green, against its 240° axis)
thin dashed: the raw sum u + v + w, which is 1.5× the α + jβ arrow
